title: R2. Two-form route obligation
milestone_description: There is c>0 such that for all sufficiently large n there are integers with b1*a2 != b2*a1 and both |b_i+a_i*zeta(9)| below exp(-c*n). This is the open analytic obligation of the mission's main two-form route and the child of the goal's two-form reduction; it packages the open exponential margin J, the coefficient map F, the analytic decay A and the Gauss bound G. It is strictly stronger than the goal and is not equivalent to it.
